environment.description: Same EC2 instance and monolith deployment behind AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to the POST /api/v1/session/restore method. The method has a Model schema (content-type application/json) that enforces: sessionData must match pattern '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{20,512}={0,2}$' with maxLength 512. The request validator is set to 'Validate body' mode. API Gateway returns 400 before forwarding if the body fails schema validation. Additionally, the integration type is HTTP_PROXY to the internal ALB (private subnet). Note: the API Gateway model uses JSON Schema draft-04 with 'pattern' and 'maxLength' constraints on the sessionData field specifically.
